title: arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. rosei
intro: Arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. rosei, commonly known as 'Point Reyes manzanita', is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. rosei include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial agent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
